verdict.rationale: Mercury exposes a well-documented public REST API (accounts, transactions, cards, invoicing, payments, webhooks, treasury) with versioned base paths, an interactive API reference with live request runner, an OAuth2 flow, scoped API tokens, an official Go SDK, sandbox environment, and an llms.txt/markdown index explicitly aimed at AI agents, plus an official MCP server and CLI/skills for agentic use. Missing for 10: independent third-party corroboration of API robustness/documentation completeness beyond Mercury's own docs, and no official Python/Node SDK (only community packages).
